global.title: Global musical attributes
global.prompt: Analyze only the supplied audio. Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Use this shape: {"duration_seconds": number_or_null, "tempo_bpm": number_or_null, "time_signature": string_or_null, "global_key": string_or_null, "key_changes": [{"start_seconds": number, "end_seconds": number, "key": string, "confidence": number}], "confidence": number_between_0_and_1, "uncertainties": [string]}. Do not infer facts from the filename. Use null and explain in uncertainties when evidence is insufficient. For key names use forms such as C major or A minor.

structure.title: Functional section structure
structure.prompt: Segment only the supplied audio into functional musical sections. Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Use this shape: {"sections": [{"id": "s1", "start_seconds": number, "end_seconds": number, "label": "intro|verse|pre_chorus|chorus|bridge|solo|outro|instrumental|unknown", "confidence": number_between_0_and_1, "alternative_labels": [{"label": string, "confidence": number_between_0_and_1}], "repeated_from": string_or_null, "evidence": string}], "uncertainties": [string]}. Sections must be chronological, non-overlapping, and cover the audible clip as completely as the evidence permits. repeated_from must reference an earlier section id or be null. Preserve plausible alternative labels instead of hiding ambiguity.

harmony.title: Timestamped chord sequence
harmony.prompt: Analyze only the supplied audio and transcribe chords conservatively. Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Use this shape: {"chords": [{"start_seconds": number, "end_seconds": number, "label": string, "confidence": number_between_0_and_1, "evidence": string}], "uncertainties": [string]}. Use Harte-style labels such as C:maj, A:min7, G:7, F#:dim, or N for no reliable chord. Chords must be chronological and non-overlapping. Prefer a coarse reliable sequence over fabricated fine timing.
